fields.name: accessible_paths
fields.description: Specify the allowlist of paths to be able to access paths from Wasm programs.

fields.name: event_format
fields.description: Define event format to interact with Wasm programs: msgpack or json.

fields.name: function_name
fields.description: Wasm function name that will be triggered to do filtering.

fields.name: wasm_heap_size
fields.description: Size of the heap size of Wasm execution.

fields.name: wasm_path
fields.description: Path to the built Wasm program that will be used.

fields.name: wasm_stack_size
fields.description: Size of the stack size of Wasm execution.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
